title: Queue, background and interrupt work
steps: While a task runs, choose Queue next rather than implicit interrupt.
Edit or remove the queued item before admission.
Inspect the owned background process and bounded output.
Deliberately stop the correct process/task/session; these are separate scopes.
Switch sessions with per-session drafts intact.
Lost stream marks the projection stale; reconnect from the durable cursor before enabling duplicate effects.
forbidden_fake_states: stop shown as confirmed remote rollback
complete_when: each queue item/process/control retains owner, generation and durable result (p.185).
